QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Charge the Fleet Signals
QuestInfo.1:
When the Fleet Signals are fully charged, they'll light the path the Expedition must follow. Work with others to build up a high charge on all of the Fleet Signals by using #b#i4009461# #t4009461##k, which you can get from monsters at certain times.

#bYou can only charge energy during certain times, and you can check to see your charge cooldown through the chat window.#k
